name: Rhys Llewellyn
bio:
Rhys Llewellyn is a young but rapidly rising star in the world of motorsport management. Hailing from a small village in North Wales, his passion for racing was ignited early, spending countless hours tinkering with go-karts and dreaming of Formula One. He studied engineering at Cardiff University, supplementing his theoretical knowledge with practical experience working on local rally teams.

While his technical knowledge is solid, Rhys realized his true strength lies in leadership and team coordination. He believes in fostering a collaborative and supportive environment, empowering his staff to take initiative and push boundaries. His calm demeanor under pressure, combined with his sharp analytical skills, makes him a natural strategist, capable of making critical decisions even in the heat of competition. He's determined to prove that age is just a number and that a fresh perspective can revitalize even the most established racing teams.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled with a slight side part.
physical.description: Rhys is a young man of average height with a focused and intelligent look.

quirks: Always carries a worn copy of Sun Tzu's 'The Art of War'.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping his pen on the table when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific type of Welsh tea available in the team garage at all times.
